doc.title: Ray Bryant interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998

title: Newport 1957 with Hawkins and Eldridge
summary: Rowe cites a 1957 Newport solo; Bryant does not remember it.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis

blocks.x: Yeah. It was a good night then. One of the things I read about you happened to mention a night, the Newport Jazz Festival in 1957, and they went so far as to make a note of a solo that you played on, let’s see you were with Coleman Hawkins and Roy Eldridge. “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me.” They mentioned that you really ripped it up on that or something.
I don’t remember. It’s been a long time since I’ve heard that record. I’ll have to check it out.
